drhp.business: Bhagwati Autocast Limited (BAL) manufactures Cast Iron (CI) and Spheroidal Graphite Iron (SGI) castings from a facility near Bavla, Ahmedabad. Its product range caters to the tractor and automobile industries, supplying components to OE manufacturers, so its fortunes are closely linked to the growth of the tractor sector and to agricultural activity and farmers' income. Alongside castings the Company sells patterns and operates captive ground-mounted solar power capacity.

risks.note: As a supplier of components to OE manufacturers in the tractor industry, the Company is directly impacted by factors affecting that sector. Management states the tractor industry's performance is closely tied to the agricultural sector's health, and that crop yield fluctuations, climate change and changes in agricultural policies can impact demand for tractors.
risks.risk: End-market concentration in the tractor industry, tied to the agricultural cycle

risks.note: Economic downturns or fluctuations can impact agricultural incomes and investment in machinery; changes in commodity prices and rural economic conditions can influence farmers' purchasing power and demand for tractors. Management explicitly links the Company's fortunes to farmers' income, particularly through minimum support prices (MSP).
The Directors' Report states profit before tax has been impacted due to a rise in input costs and other operating costs — a direct margin risk for a foundry with commodity metal inputs.
risks.risk: Input and operating cost inflation compressing margins

risks.note: Management flags that rapid technological advancements present risks if companies fail to keep pace, and that investments in new technologies such as electric or autonomous tractors may pose financial risks if market adoption is slower than anticipated. The automobile sector is separately described as in a robust transition towards electric vehicles.
risks.risk: Technology-transition risk in the vehicles the Company supplies (EV and autonomous tractors)

risks.note: Management states stricter environmental regulations and emission standards can impose additional compliance costs on manufacturers, and adapting may require significant investment in new technologies and production processes — material for an energy-intensive foundry.
risks.risk: Tightening environmental regulation and emission standards

risks.note: The auditor's report carries an Emphasis of Matter drawing attention to Note No. 46 regarding pending confirmation/reconciliation and consequential adjustments in respect of trade receivables, creditors and advances (the opinion is not modified in respect of the matter). It is a standing balance-integrity and working-capital control issue.
risks.risk: Unreconciled trade receivables, creditors and advances flagged by the statutory auditor

risks.note: The Company operates one manufacturing facility, near Bavla, Ahmedabad, producing CI and SGI castings, so a disruption at that site or in that product line has no internal fallback. The Directors' Report confirms the Company has no subsidiary, joint venture or associate company, so there is no diversification of the operating base.

The CFO resigned with effect from 12th May, 2025 and a successor was appointed only from 3rd October, 2025; the Company Secretary & Compliance Officer appointed with effect from 6th January, 2025 resigned with effect from 3rd October, 2025. Repeated churn in Section 203 KMP positions is a continuity and compliance risk for a company with 68 permanent staff on its rolls.
